title: skills(objectstack-data security): renaming a position — tell the author to re-point their own package source, and name the environment owner
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (follow-ups from the at-tier contract review 6886676047 of merged PR #33480, card #33044).

The "Renaming a position" paragraph in `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` (merged as `8e63ed87`) holds, with three gaps worth a sentence:
1. It does not tell the author to re-point their own package source that names the old position (a sharing-rule recipient, an approval `position:NAME` slot, RLS over `positions`). "The boot log lists other references for an admin" can read as nothing else to do.
2. "Recorded under another package" omits the environment as owner (the `sys_metadata` sentinel).
3. The card's premise said Setup-authored bodies are read by the holder carry; they are not. Say so, or confirm it against `position-renamed-holder-carry.ts` and record the reading.

Also restore, somewhere in `skills/**`, the operator rule cut by the PR: the explain endpoint needs `manage_users`. `@objectstack/skills` patch. Token ratchet paid in place.
